INSERT INTO group_link_health ( group_link_id, health_status, is_banned, current_count, last_check_at, last_health_error, health_failure_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{groupLinkId}, #{healthStatus}, #{banned}, #{currentCount}, #{lastCheckAt}, #{lastHealthError}, #{healthFailureCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE health_status = CASE WHEN COALESCE(is_banned, 0) = 1 THEN health_status ELSE VALUES(health_status) END, is_banned = CASE WHEN COALESCE(is_banned, 0) = 1 THEN is_banned ELSE VALUES(is_banned) END, current_count = COALESCE(VALUES(current_count), current_count), last_check_at = VALUES(last_check_at), last_health_error = CASE WHEN COALESCE(is_banned, 0) = 1 THEN last_health_error ELSE VALUES(last_health_error) END, health_failure_count = CASE WHEN COALESCE(is_banned, 0) = 1 THEN health_failure_count ELSE VALUES(health_failure_count) END, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
